title: Forbidden linear gradients and rectangular control shapes
description: The showcase CSS contains linear gradients on range sliders and skeleton indicators. Also, copy buttons inside source lines use a four-pixel border radius instead of pill geometry. These implementations violate the explicit Universal Language texture rules that ban gradients on chrome and mandate that all tappable controls use pill shapes.

note.content: /app/showcase.html:L418, L462 — Line 418 uses `linear-gradient` for range slider track filling, and line 462 uses `linear-gradient` for skeleton loading animations.
/app/showcase.html:L438 — Line 438 defines `.src .cp` copy buttons with `border-radius: 4px` instead of pill geometry (`9999px`).

/app/LANGUAGE.md:L19, L23, L83 — Line 19 prohibits gradients on chrome across any platform, line 23 requires pill shapes for tappable controls, and line 83 explicitly specifies pill shape for buttons.
/app/DESIGN.md:L124, L128, L160 — Line 124 prohibits gradients on chrome and surfaces, line 128 mandates `Pill (9999px) = tappable`, and line 160 reinforces `Buttons: pill`.
